download.title: Download · MineDeck
download.desc: Download MineDeck stable and beta builds from a China mirror, with SHA-256 checksums.
download.lead: A single exe, no installer. Windows 64-bit only. The app interface is in Chinese.
download.betaDiff: Adds handover packs, the mod cart, pending modpack files, adopting existing servers and per-server Java.
download.betaWarn: Run betas from their own folder and back up before trying an existing server. Betas do not auto-update to each other.
download.companionP: AI companions need the companion mod on each friend's client, matching the server version. Pick the one for the server's loader and put it in the client's mods folder. The server-side mod installed from the Companion tab does not replace it.
install: Put MineDeck.exe in its own folder. Servers, Java, cache and backups live there by default.
If Windows says “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway. The exe is not code-signed.
download.smartAria: SmartScreen illustration: More info reveals Run anyway
download.verifyP: Open PowerShell in the exe's folder, run the command below, and compare the output with the SHA-256 above:
download.verifyNote: Every file and its SHA-256 is on the release page; you can also download SHA256SUMS.
req: The UI runs in a WebView2 window, or your default browser if WebView2 is missing.

Upgrading from v2.6.1 or earlier (file name AutoMCHUB.exe): auto-update cannot find the renamed file, so place MineDeck.exe in the old folder manually. The old autostart entry is removed; turn it back on in Settings → Startup & tray if needed.
To uninstall, delete the exe's folder and %LocalAppData%\MineDeck.
download.mirrorP: Files on the China mirror are identical to GitHub, with the same SHA-256. If the mirror lacks a file, the button points to GitHub instead.
download.mirrorPlaceholder: The mirror address is a placeholder until launch.

feedback.title: Feedback · MineDeck
feedback.desc: Report a MineDeck bug, suggestion or beta feedback without a GitHub account.
feedback.lead: No GitHub account needed. When you are done, copy the report or send it through one of the channels below.
feedback.beforeLatest: Is it fixed in the latest release, {tag}?
feedback.noJs: This form needs JavaScript. You can also open an issue on GitHub directly.
feedback.caseIdHint: ID from the test plan, e.g. F-08, or what you were doing
feedback.logsHint: Drop a .log or .txt file here. It is read in your browser and never uploaded. Long logs keep the first 200 and last 400 lines.
feedback.shots: Screenshots: the copy and GitHub channels cannot attach images; paste them into the issue.
feedback.contactHint: Email or QQ. Only sent through the direct channel, never in copied or GitHub reports.
feedback.confirm: I checked that the report contains no API keys, passwords or tunnel credentials
feedback.warn: Never include API keys, LAN passwords, SakuraFrp access keys or CurseForge keys. When the report is built, Windows user names, IP addresses and common key formats in logs are replaced; check the preview.
feedback.draft: Drafts are stored only in your browser.
feedback.githubNote: Needs a GitHub account; may not load in mainland China.
feedback.githubLong: Logs were too long and have been copied to the clipboard; paste them into the issue.
feedback.sendFail: Sending failed: {msg}. Your draft is kept; use Copy report instead.
feedback.copiedMsg: Report copied. Paste it into an issue or a group chat.
feedback.copyManual: Could not copy automatically. The preview text is selected; press Ctrl+C.

about.title: About · MineDeck
about.desc: About MineDeck: the project, contributors, activity, how to contribute and the license.
intro: MineDeck is a Minecraft: Java Edition server manager for Windows: it downloads Java and server software and lets you create, import and manage servers in one window.

It manages server processes and files on your own PC. It does not provide cloud servers, host worlds, or buy or run servers for you. AI features are optional; with no key set it connects to no AI service.
MineDeck was called AutoMCHUB. It was renamed with {renamed}; 2.x releases still ship AutoMCHUB.exe.
